Why patients choose Pearl

Dentistry that feels calm, honest, and genuinely on your side

We built Pearl around the things people tell us they wish every dentist did: explain clearly, never upsell, and make the whole visit comfortable from hello to goodbye.

  • Modern technology

    Digital X-rays with up to 80% less radiation, intraoral cameras, and same-day CEREC crowns so you leave with the work done.

  • Gentle, unhurried care

    Numbing that actually works, sedation options for anxious patients, and a team that checks in with you at every step.

  • Flexible financing

    Interest-free payment plans and CareCredit make bigger treatments easy to fit into your monthly budget — no surprises.

  • Most insurance accepted

    We’re in-network with major PPO plans and file your claims for you, so you get the maximum benefit with minimum paperwork.

Good to know

Questions, answered

Still wondering something?

Our front desk is happy to talk it through — no pressure, no obligation.

Call (312) 555-0119
Do you accept my insurance?

We’re in-network with most major PPO plans including Delta Dental, Cigna, Aetna, MetLife, and Guardian, and we happily file claims for out-of-network plans too. Bring your card to your first visit and our team will verify your benefits before any treatment so you know exactly what’s covered.

I’m nervous about the dentist. Can you help?

Absolutely — a large share of our patients came to us specifically because of dental anxiety. We offer nitrous oxide (laughing gas) and oral sedation, take everything at your pace, and never proceed without your okay. Just tell us at booking and we’ll build extra comfort into your appointment.

Do you see children?

Yes! Dr. Nadeau leads our kids dentistry program and we welcome children from their first tooth onward. Visits are playful and fear-free, with gentle cleanings, fluoride, and sealants. Booking the whole family on the same day is easy — just let us know the ages when you schedule.

What if I have a dental emergency?

Call our emergency line at (312) 555-0100 and we’ll get you in the same day — we hold slots open daily for urgent problems like a knocked-out tooth, severe pain, or a lost crown. If you’re in pain right now, phone us first; step-by-step first-aid guidance is on the way while you head over.

How much does teeth whitening cost?

In-office Zoom whitening starts at $299 for a single one-hour session that lifts teeth several shades in one visit. Custom take-home trays are $199, and we often bundle both. You’ll get an exact quote at your consult, and whitening is discounted for Smile Membership members.

Can I pay in installments?

Yes. We offer 0% interest in-house payment plans on treatment over $500 and partner with CareCredit for longer-term financing. For patients without insurance, our $34/month Smile Membership covers routine care and unlocks 15% off other treatments. We’ll help you find the option that fits your budget.

How often should I come in?

For most healthy adults, a checkup and cleaning every six months keeps problems small and catches issues early. If you have gum disease, a history of decay, or certain health conditions, we may recommend visits every three to four months. We’ll tailor a schedule to you — and send friendly reminders.

Are you accepting new patients?

We are — and we usually have same-week openings. New patients get a complete exam, digital X-rays, and a cleaning for $89. Book online in under a minute or call us, and our front desk will confirm your time within one business hour.
